resources.string: QR code to bring settings from another TV

On the OLD TV, open the panel (phone or computer), go to System › Backup › \"Move to a new TV\" and scan this QR or type the code below.\nEverything goes encrypted, only to this TV. The code lasts %1$s.
Receiving… don\'t turn off the TV.
Everything came from %1$s. The TV restarts now; then your apps come back one by one.
It didn\'t work: %1$s\nNothing changed on this TV. Press \"%2$s\" to try again.
The code expired (it lasts 10 min).\nPress \"%1$s\" to show a new one.
Settings, PIN, channels and apps of the old TV in 2 minutes, with a QR
App %1$d of %2$d. Open it in the Play Store and press Install; when you come back, the next one shows up.
